process_area.title: Print Quality, Compliance, Document Security & Analytics

value_stream.name: Blueprint, Reprographics & Large-Format Plan Printing Services

fields.Participants: Operator, Quality, Metrology (VS-115), Store Services Lead
fields.Trigger: Each completed job (W5090/W5092); calibration cycle; defect/complaint

workflows.name: Print Quality, Color/Scale Accuracy & Dimensional Verification

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-scale/color verification; defect-rate analytics; calibration-due auto-alert (W5088)
Controls: - CTL-760: QC before release; scale verified (VS-115); calibration current (W5088)
Cross-references: - links to VS-115 (calibration); W5088 (maintenance), W5090 (printing), W5099 (analytics), W5102 (complaints)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scale-error risk**: Wrong print scale → jobsite/construction error (high-consequence for B2B); mitigated by dimensional verification (VS-115)
- **Defect-acceptance risk**: Defective print accepted → complaint/rework; mitigated by QC before release
- **Calibration-drift risk**: Color/scale drift unnoticed; mitigated by calibration cycle (W5088/VS-115)
System Touchpoints: - Quality/dimensional check; calibration/metrology (VS-115); print-management (W5086); analytics (W5099); maintenance (W5088)

steps.activity: Verify print quality: line definition, color accuracy (profile), no banding/bleed/smudge, media integrity, and finishing quality (binding/folding)
Verify scale/dimensional accuracy: print-to-scale correctness (critical for construction plans — a wrong scale is a jobsite error), using calibrated measurement (VS-115)
Defect handling & rework: re-print defects (W5090), log defect rate, and feed calibration/maintenance (W5088) + analytics (W5099)

fields.Participants: Analytics (VS-28), Facilities (VS-138), IT (VS-27), Store Services Lead
fields.Trigger: Monthly analytics; downtime incident; capacity planning (W5103)

workflows.name: Reprographics Equipment Performance, Utilization & Downtime Management

Automation Opportunity: - Equipment telemetry → uptime/utilization dashboard; downtime auto-alert; reliability analytics
Controls: - CTL-760 (ensure controlled execution — Print Quality, Compliance, Document Security & Analytics (PA-176.3).)
- CTL-760: uptime SLA tracked (W5088); utilization reconciled to jobs; PM adherence (VS-138)
Cross-references: - links to VS-138 (CMMS), VS-28 (analytics), VS-27 (IT); W5082 (equipment), W5088 (maintenance), W5103 (capacity), W5104 (ROI)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Uptime risk**: Frequent downtime → service unreliability & customer loss; mitigated by PM + SLA (W5088)
- **Utilization-blindness risk**: Under-/over-utilized equipment; mitigated by utilization analytics → rebalancing
- **Capacity-shortfall risk**: Capacity insufficient at peak (bid cycle); mitigated by capacity planning (W5103)
System Touchpoints: - Print-management telemetry (W5086); CMMS (VS-138); analytics/BI (VS-28); IT (VS-27); capex (VS-35)

steps.activity: Track performance KPIs: uptime, utilization (% busy), throughput (sqm/hr), MTBF, and downtime hours per equipment/site
Diagnose downtime: root-cause (breakdown/supply/PM), SLA adherence (W5088), and substitute-capacity effectiveness
Drive reliability & capacity: PM/capex plan (W5088/W5082), capacity expansion/rebalancing (W5103), and feed program ROI (W5104)

fields.Participants: Analytics (VS-28), Inventory (VS-05), FP&A (VS-17.4), Store Services Lead, Cost Accounting (VS-158)
fields.Trigger: Monthly analytics; costing cycle; margin review

workflows.name: Consumables Yield, Print-Cost Accounting & Margin Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - Consumables-yield auto-accounting; per-job cost auto-calc; margin dashboard
Controls: - CTL-760 (ensure controlled execution — Print Quality, Compliance, Document Security & Analytics (PA-176.3).)
- CTL-760: consumables reconciled to jobs (W5084); cost-per-sqm validated (VS-158); margin reconciled (VS-17.4)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-05 (inventory), VS-158 (cost), VS-17.4 (FP&A); W5083 (pricing), W5084 (consumables), W5097 (quality)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Yield-loss risk**: Excess ink/media consumption → margin leakage; mitigated by yield analytics + calibration
- **Cost-blindness risk**: Jobs costed without full burden → margin illusion; mitigated by cost-per-sqm accounting
- **Waste risk**: High waste %; mitigated by defect reduction (W5097)
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (VS-28); inventory (VS-05); cost/landed cost (VS-158); pricing (VS-01.2); FP&A (VS-17.4); print-management (W5086)

steps.activity: Track consumables yield: ink/media consumption per sqm/job, yield variance, waste %, and consumables inventory accuracy (W5084)
Cost-account each job: media + ink + machine + labor + overhead per job (cost-per-sqm — W5083), landed cost of consumables (VS-158), and waste cost
Analyse margin & act: gross margin by service/media/site, feed pricing (W5083), consumables sourcing (W5084), and FP&A (VS-17.4)

fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), Privacy/DPO (VS-91), Legal (VS-100), Compliance (VS-22), Store Services Lead
fields.Trigger: Job intake/retention (W5089); disposal cycle; privacy refresh; DSAR

workflows.name: Customer Document Confidentiality, RA 10173 Data-Privacy & Secure Disposal

Automation Opportunity: - Retention auto-purge; access-control logging; DSAR workflow; breach-detection (VS-91)
Controls: - CTL-760 (ensure controlled execution — Print Quality, Compliance, Document Security & Analytics (PA-176.3).)
- CTL-760: consent at intake (RA 10173/VS-91); retention enforced; access controlled (VS-27); secure-disposal with chain-of-custody; DSAR handled
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-91 (privacy/DPO), VS-100 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-21 (audit), VS-88 (records); W5087 (IP), W5089 (intake), W5093 (storage)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retention-violation risk**: Holding documents beyond consent (RA 10173); mitigated by retention policy + auto-purge
- **Breach risk**: Customer plan/bid data leaked; mitigated by encryption + access control + breach response (VS-91)
- **Disposal-compliance risk**: Insecure shred/purge; mitigated by secure-disposal protocol + chain-of-custody
System Touchpoints: - IT security/access control (VS-27); privacy/DPO (VS-91); print-management retention (W5086); secure-disposal; records (VS-88); audit (VS-21)
Time Estimate: - ~policy at setup; periodic disposal cycle; per DSAR/incident

steps.activity: Govern document confidentiality & RA 10173: consent at intake (W5087/W5089), purpose/retention limits, access control on stored files (W5093), and sealed-bid/sensitive handling
Secure-dispose: physical-document secure shred, digital-file secure-purge per retention policy, and chain-of-custody documentation
Handle DSAR/incident: data-subject access requests (RA 10173), breach response (VS-91), and audit evidence (VS-21)

fields.Trigger: Software/cloud setup; license renewal; system admin
fields.Volume: ~3–5 print-management software + cloud + RIP licenses per site

workflows.name: Software License, Cloud Subscription & Print-Management System Administration

Automation Opportunity: - License-utilization monitoring (VS-99); cloud-spend FinOps (VS-135); patching automation
Controls: - CTL-760: licenses compliant (VS-99); spend within budget (VS-135); system patched/secured (VS-27)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-99 (SAM), VS-135 (FinOps), VS-03 (vendor); W5086 (portal), W5083 (pricing config)
Pain Points / Risks: - **License-compliance risk**: Under-licensed software → audit penalty; mitigated by SAM (VS-99)
- **Spend-leakage risk**: Under-used cloud/licenses; mitigated by FinOps/utilization (VS-135)
- **Integration/security risk**: Mis-configured system/integration; mitigated by IT admin + patching (VS-27)
System Touchpoints: - IT/SAM (VS-99); TBM/FinOps (VS-135); IT operations (VS-27); print-management config (W5086); procurement/vendor (VS-03)

steps.activity: Manage licenses & subscriptions: print-management software, RIP (raster image processor), cloud (W5086), license count vs usage, and renewal/true-up (links VS-99/VS-135)
Administer the print-management system: user/role access, job-queue, pricing/tariff config (W5083), integrations (POS/O2C VS-08/VS-16), and security patching
Cost-optimize & govern: software/cloud spend vs budget (VS-135), license utilization (eliminate shelfware), and vendor management (VS-03)

fields.Participants: Customer Service (VS-13), Store Services Lead, Operator/Quality, CX assurance (VS-146)

workflows.name: Reprographics Customer Satisfaction, Complaint & Rework Management

Automation Opportunity: - Ticket auto-routing; VOC→program analytics; defect-root-cause trending
Controls: - CTL-760 (ensure controlled execution — Print Quality, Compliance, Document Security & Analytics (PA-176.3).)
- CTL-760: SLA + escalation (VS-13); refunds O2C-controlled (VS-16); systemic defects fed to program (W5104)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-146 (CX assurance), VS-16 (O2C); W5090 (reprint), W5097 (quality), W5099 (analytics), W5104 (program)
Pain Points / Risks: - **SLA-breach risk**: Slow resolution → customer churn (B2B account loss); mitigated by SLA + escalation (VS-13)
- **Repeat-defect risk**: Systemic quality defect unresolved; mitigated by root-cause + feedback (W5097/W5099)
- **B2B-account-loss risk**: A bad reprographics experience on bid day loses a trade account; mitigated by priority B2B handling
System Touchpoints: - CX/ticketing (VS-13.1); print-management (W5086); O2C/refund (VS-16); VOC analytics (VS-28); CX assurance (VS-146)

steps.activity: Intake & triage: capture complaint (quality/late/defect/billing), classify, route, and acknowledge within SLA (VS-13)

steps.a: Store Services Lead / Customer Service Manager
steps.activity: Resolve & rework: address the issue (re-print W5090, refund W5096, expedite), root-cause the defect (links W5097/W5099), and confirm resolution with customer
Close & learn: record VOC/resolution (VS-13), feed CX analytics & mystery-shopping (VS-146), and flag systemic defects to the program (W5104)

fields.Participants: Analytics (VS-28), Store Ops (VS-07), Trade Pro (VS-43), S&OP (VS-127), HR/Staffing (VS-19.3)
fields.Trigger: Planning cycle; bid/permit season; capacity review

workflows.name: Service Demand Seasonality, Capacity Forecasting & Staffing

Automation Opportunity: - Time-series demand model; bid-cycle scenario planning; staffing recommendation
Controls: - CTL-760 (ensure controlled execution — Print Quality, Compliance, Document Security & Analytics (PA-176.3).)
- CTL-760: forecast reconciled to actuals; capacity/staffing within budget; feeds S&OP (VS-127)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-19.3 (WFM), VS-127 (S&OP), VS-43 (trade pro); W5084 (consumables), W5095 (bid-set), W5098 (capacity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Peak-capacity risk**: Insufficient capacity at bid cycle → deadline-miss/customer loss (W5095); mitigated by seasonality forecast
- **Over-staffing risk**: Excess staff in low season; mitigated by demand-driven staffing (VS-19.3)
- **Consumables-shortage risk**: Ink/media out at peak; mitigated by demand-linked replenishment (W5084)
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/forecasting (VS-28); WFM/staffing (VS-19.3); S&OP (VS-127); CRM/account pipeline (VS-43/VS-107); consumables (W5084)

steps.activity: Forecast demand: model job seasonality (bid/permit cycles, construction season, government fiscal-year bidding), trade-pro account pipeline (VS-43), and external drivers
Plan capacity & staffing: translate demand to equipment capacity (W5098), consumables (W5084), and counter staffing (VS-19.3) for peak windows
Reconcile & refine: compare forecast to actual, adjust capacity/staffing, and feed S&OP (VS-127)

fields.Participants: FP&A (VS-17.4), Analytics (VS-28), Trade Pro (VS-43), Strategy (VS-33), Store Ops (VS-07)

workflows.name: Reprographics Program Performance, ROI & Cross-Sell Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - Reprographics↔account transaction linkage; ROI dashboard; scenario/planning model
Controls: - CTL-760 (ensure controlled execution — Print Quality, Compliance, Document Security & Analytics (PA-176.3).)
- CTL-760: program P&L reconciled to FP&A (VS-17.4); capex within VS-35 envelope; cross-sell measured consistently
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-28 (analytics), VS-43/VS-107 (trade/B2B), VS-33 (strategy), VS-13 (CRM); W5081 (strategy), W5083 (pricing), W5098 (capacity), W5102 (CX)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stranded-capex risk**: Under-performing sites not exited; mitigated by site-level ROI review
- **Cross-sell-blindness risk**: Service viewed in isolation vs its B2B-attach contribution; mitigated by linkage analytics
- **Strategic-drift risk**: Program not adapting to B2B demand/tech; mitigated by annual refresh (W5081)
System Touchpoints: - FP&A (VS-17.4); analytics/BI (VS-28); CRM/account (VS-43/VS-107); capex (VS-35); strategy (VS-33); CX (VS-13)

steps.activity: Measure program ROI & P&L: revenue, gross margin, equipment/utilization, operating cost, and program P&L vs business case (W5081)
Quantify cross-sell & attach: reprographics→trade-pro/B2B account linkage (VS-43/VS-107), bid-set→project-win correlation, and store-traffic/dwell lift
Steer & improve: site expansion/pause/exit, pricing/yield (W5083), capacity (W5098), corrective from complaints (W5102), and strategy refresh (W5081)
